verdict: Claude path: 106/120 h (88.3%), needs-work 53/66 (80.3%), 0 m, 0 broken, 0 fact or meaning changes; every number, handle, tag, link, code tick and negation survived, sarcasm and meaning-flip lines were left alone, and stance hedges on forecasts were kept with honest receipts. It matches or beats Typefully on safety and on explaining itself; it trails slightly on punch because it only cuts and splits. Short of 9.5 on h% (88 vs 90) and on two voice/content losses (m-46, m-91). On-device: 93/120 h (77.5%), needs-work 41/66 (62.1%), 7 m, 2 broken (both over-280 lines: post 2 still over 280 and starts mid-sentence), 1 referent shift (m-90), 3 false explanations, and the homepage Try box disagrees with the engine on m-61. Call marks help where the hedge is real stance (m-0, m-25, m-34, m-72, m-113, m-118) and distract where they sit on "I think" next to an uncut run-up (m-62, m-116 on-device). The one validator reject (m-38) was a false positive, harmless here.
to_95: Claude: leave already-sharp lines fully alone - no dropping a parenthetical aside (m-91) or an announcement sentence (m-46).

Claude: when two intensifiers stack ("actually totally", m-8) or a soft tail remains (m-9, m-44, m-110), cut one or call-mark it, and never add an intensifier the writer did not write (m-16 "so weird").
Claude: catch plain "basically" (m-105) so the model path is never behind the fallback.
Validator: treat "whether or not X" -> "whether X" as meaning-preserving and fix the reject message so it names "not".
On-device: fix the long-line split - post 2 must be <=280 and a whole sentence; trim marked fluff from post 1.

On-device: cut announce run-ups ("In today's thread, I'm going to walk you through", "In this thread I will be explaining", "Just wanted to share a few quick thoughts on", "Here's a thing that") the way it already cuts "I wanted to share".
On-device: prefer the cut-only alt over the result-first reorder when the line has a trailing pronoun reference (m-90).
On-device: fix false whys (m-114 "I think" inside "how I think about work"; m-19 "news like this"; m-96 "without it the line breaks").
Homepage: make the Try box show what sharpenLine returns (m-61).

issues.problem: Post 2 is 327 / 288 chars (over 280) and starts mid-sentence ("and I honestly...", "which is the fact that..."); post 1 is pure run-up with marked fluff (So, really) left in; top-level rest is empty while the note says the rest becomes post 2.
issues.fix: Split on real sentence ends only, re-split until every post is <=280, apply cuts to post 1, and fall back to cut-only if no clean split exists.

issues.problem: Run-ups are marked or missed but kept, so the weakest lines ship unchanged; m-92 gets no mark at all.
issues.fix: Cut the run-up and promote the "how/why/what" clause to a header with a colon, as the Claude path does.

issues.problem: Adds "what changed:" and moves "i didn't expect that" so it points at the rewrite, not the latency drop.
issues.fix: Block the reorder when a later sentence has a bare this/that/it pointing back; ship the cut-only alt.

issues.problem: False receipts: "Kept I think" where the words are "how I think about work"; "news like this" on an opinion; "without it the line breaks" when it does not.
issues.fix: Only emit the stance note when the hedge mark exists at that span; gate the news note on the news detector; test the break claim by actually removing the phrase.

issues.problem: HWCore.sharpenLine returns "Your first line beats everything else combined." in the page, but the Try box shows "Kept as written" with "It goes without saying that" intact.
issues.fix: Render the engine result, or if the UI vetoes word swaps, fall back to the cut-only version instead of the draft.

issues.problem: "probably" is cut from a hot take but kept on an unpopular opinion; a deliberate vulnerable preamble is deleted as 4 bits of fluff with no call mark.
issues.fix: One rule for probably on opinions (call mark, not cut); route personal-news preambles through the keep-as-written guard or offer the trimmed line as an alt.

issues.problem: Content the writer chose is dropped from lines that did not need work: the self-aware aside and the "New issue is out!" announcement.
issues.fix: Validator: reject removal of a whole sentence or parenthetical unless it matches a known fluff pattern.

issues.problem: An intensifier added ("so weird"), stacked intensifiers and soft tails kept, "basically" missed.
issues.fix: Validator: reject added words outside a small function-word list; prompt: one intensifier per claim.

issues.problem: False positive: "whether or not your customers renew" -> "whether your customers renew" rejected as negation of "your" lost; message names the wrong word.
issues.fix: Exempt "whether or not" / "or not" after whether; report the negation token itself.

issues.problem: Counts in say do not match the why; odd receipts (", but" listed as cut; "The light edit:").
issues.fix: Derive the count from the actual diff and drop internal phrasing.
